messages:
maria: Quick note — I'm kicking off a small heuristic sampling pass on admin-like roles this week. Goal: surface sticky grants, ownerless bindings, and noisy service accounts for a least-priv sweep. Will take ~48h.

raj: thanks, good call. what's the sampling heuristic?

maria: quick summary: 
- surface roles with >1 cross-project binding OR non-human principal in last 90d activity
- flag bindings without an owner tag and roles that map to broad perms (eg. Owner, ProjectEditor, kms.admin)
- prioritize principals that have >50 last-30d API calls so we avoid cold/noise

sam: can we include KMS key usage counts in the heuristic? those owners matter a lot.

maria: yes — I'll join KMS key audit logs by principal and look for decrypt/encrypt ops. will also flag keys with admin-like bindings.

kevin: FYI add a field for "recently escalated" from our elevation logs (temp-elevations table) so we catch folks who rotated into admin.

maria: good call. also planning to pull CloudAudit logs for iam.* and kms.* events and slice by principal -> resource.

raj: any concerns on audit log retention limits? some projects have short retention.

maria: noted — for short retention projects we'll mark the evidence as "incomplete" and route to owning infra teams. also leaving a ticket template: 
```
Owner: @team
Evidence: missing cloud-audit logs (retention 7d)
Action: request extended retention / manual export
```

sec-oncall-bot: [automated] queued export request created for project: telemetry-prod (expires in 48h)

sam: will you share the sample query? would like to replicate for Dedicated infra.

maria: yep — rough SQL below (pseudo):
```
SELECT principal, role, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(kms_ops) AS kms_ops
FROM iam_bindings b
LEFT JOIN audit_logs a ON a.principal = b.principal
LEFT JOIN kms_usage k ON k.principal = b.principal
WHERE a.timestamp > now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY principal, role
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 OR SUM(kms_ops) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(kms_ops) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

kevin: nice. when you have results, can you tag me for any "project-admin" hits in production? I'll handle owner outreach.

maria: will do. plan: run initial pass tonight, quick triage tomorrow morning, then send owners a short notice (template below).

maria: notice template: 
"Hi — we're running a routine least-privilege sweep and detected a binding (role: {{role}}) for {{principal}} on {{resource}} without an owner tag. Please confirm ownership or request removal by EOD +3. If this is required, please add an owner tag and justify with short reason"

raj: one more ask — capture whether bindings are from infra-as-code (repo link) vs console. that affects remediation path.

maria: agreed — we'll join with iam_change_history to see origin and include the repo/url if present.

sam: copying ops: @kevin @maria @raj :eyes: let us know if you want us to bulk apply owner tags for infra teams after confirmations.

maria: thanks. I'll post the results file in #eng-security when ready and open a tiny ticket per high-risk hit. expect ~20-40 high-confidence items.

kevin: :thumbsup: appreciate it.

maria: TL;DR: small heuristic sample for admin-ish bindings, includes KMS usage and elevation cross-check, retention gaps flagged, owner outreach workflow ready.
